collections.name: Rome version 2

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes.

collections.place: Rome metropolitan area and Sacrofano, Italy
collections.acquisition: Moving-vehicle GoPro HERO7 video frames and stationary Samsung Galaxy A14 phone photos.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned YOLO text and COCO JSON, with original normalized four-point quadrilaterals.
collections.label_layout: data/images/<stem>.jpg joins data/labels-YOLO/<stem>.txt. Original quadrilaterals are in data/labels/<stem>.txt. The consolidated alternative is data/annotations_coco.json.
collections.count_source: All 2,009 YOLO bbox labels, matched by stem to JPEGs in the v2 ZIP directory.
collections.block_unit: Source video or stationary capture session (candidate)
collections.block_rule: Recover actual video/session IDs if available. The filenames identify 1,695 dated VLC snapshots, 212 numeric VLC snapshots and 102 dated phone photos. VLC snapshot timestamps and phone timestamps are grouping clues. No clip-ID map or GPS manifest was listed. The paper describes irregular frame selection from continuous video. Verify any grouping by provenance or image clustering.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: Original Italian capture reported. Italy is outside the RDD2022 country list. Check content using the protocol rule.
problems: Source video/session IDs remain unresolved for G5.
46 normalized YOLO boxes in 44 images exceed the frame or fail positive-area checks at 1e-6 tolerance, including 2 pothole boxes. Freeze a geometry rule before use.
collections.summary_problem: Session IDs unresolved. Two pothole boxes flagged.

collections.name: SVRDD Beijing

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes. The record also requires compliance with the Baidu Maps Open Platform Terms of Service for the street-view imagery.

collections.place: Beijing, China (Chaoyang, Dongcheng, Fengtai, Haidian and Xicheng)
collections.acquisition: Baidu Maps street view. Two views with different pitch angles were vertically combined for each point.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned YOLO text and Pascal VOC XML in alternative archives.
collections.label_layout: SVRDD_YOLO/<district>/images/<stem>.jpg joins <district>/labels/<stem>.txt. The VOC release joins SVRDD_VOC/<district>/JPEGImages/<stem>.jpg to <district>/Annotations/<stem>.xml. Convert backslashes in the released YOLO split lists to path separators.
collections.count_source: All 8,000 YOLO labels matched to image stems. The 918 boxes agree with the VOC labels and Figure 4 of the authors’ paper.
collections.block_unit: Road segment or spatial image cluster (recoverable candidate)
collections.block_rule: Parse <Baidu_PID>_<x>_<y>.jpg and use the paper’s Baidu BD09 coordinate convention. Establish coordinate scaling and projection before spatial clustering or snapping to roads. The sampled road-network points were 5 m apart before filtering. The release has district folders and point coordinates, and the paper supplies no road ID manifest.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: China is in RDD2022. The authors collected these images via Baidu Maps and report no RDD2022 or CRDDC input. Check China content overlap.
problems: Baidu imagery terms must be checked for the planned use and any redistribution.
Districts and random splits do not establish independent road blocks.
collections.summary_problem: Baidu terms and road-block verification pending.

collections.name: N-RDD2024, Turkey and Georgia

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes. The Mendeley record notes that identified third-party content may require further permission.

collections.place: Turkey and Georgia. Cities or routes unverified.
collections.acquisition: Device and capture setup unverified for the pinned two country releases.
collections.capture_period: Unverified. The COCO date_captured values reflect the November 20, 2024 export, per the embedded Roboflow README.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned COCO JSON and Pascal VOC XML. The *_txt.zip alternatives use eight pixel coordinates, a class token and a difficulty flag in labelTxt, as in an oriented box export.
collections.label_layout: Each COCO ZIP has train/ and valid/ JPEGs plus an _annotations.coco.json per split. Join images.id to annotations.image_id within the same JSON. VOC XML sits beside same-stem JPEGs. Oriented text pairs <split>/images/<stem>.jpg with <split>/labelTxt/<stem>.txt.
collections.count_source: Pinned Turkey and Georgia COCO JSON labels, with every JSON filename matched to its archive JPEG. Oriented-text counts agree. Turkey has 42 boxes in 37 images and Georgia has 87 boxes in 54 images.
collections.block_rule: Use the country archive as provenance. Strip .rf.<hash> only to recover original filename stems such as IMG_0210_jpeg or 10_JPG. The sequence and hash give no validated session/route ID. COCO timestamps are export metadata. No GPS or frame spacing verified.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: The overall N-RDD2024 release explicitly revises RDD2022. Only the Turkey and Georgia packages enter this inventory. Their embedded source READMEs identify separate Roboflow projects. Their country names are outside RDD2022. Image-level origin and overlap are unverified.
problems: Fails the protocol G4 minimum of 150 pothole boxes even before deduplication. The three annotation exports per country represent alternative formats and must not be added together.
The two archives have different category lists. Use the per-file class map. Their text YAML references an absent test folder.
Acquisition provenance and independent blocks remain unverified.

collections.name: EcuPDD Ecuador

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes.

collections.image_format: 1,174 JPEGs with .jpeg extension, 116 with .jpg and 5 PNGs
collections.resolution: 330 distinct sizes in image headers. Most frequent are 1200 × 1453 and 1200 × 1462 (84 each) and 1200 × 1444 (71).
collections.place: Ambato, Quito, Loja, Santo Domingo, Manta, Puyo and Zamora, Ecuador.
collections.acquisition: Smartphone photos taken on foot and from vehicles, including overhead, longitudinal and transverse viewpoints.
collections.capture_period: Field dates unverified. WhatsApp filename timestamps include May 2025 and May 2026 and can reflect sharing or export.
collections.label_layout: EPDD/{train,valid}/images/<stem>.{jpg,jpeg,png} joins EPDD/{train,valid}/labels/<stem>.txt. Use EPDD/data.yaml as the class-ID reference.
collections.count_source: All labels in the existing local EPDD.zip with MD5 matching Zenodo. 1,294 nonempty labels plus one empty train label. The authors’ source confirms 4,559 total annotations.
collections.block_unit: City, road segment or collection session (IDs unresolved)
collections.block_rule: The authors give seven city totals before exclusions. The archive contains split folders and export-prefixed names. There is no image-to-city or route map in the package. Header audit found no embedded EXIF GPS or date tags. WhatsApp names are only clues. Establish image clustering or recover the field manifest.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: Use the original Ecuador-only archive. The paper uses RDD2022 Japan, RDD2022 China_MotorBike and McMaster in separate mixtures. Ecuador is outside the RDD2022 country list.
problems: 229 boxes in 196 images fail the normalized frame-bounds/area check at 1e-6 tolerance, including 27 pothole boxes. Freeze a geometry policy before use.
The archive YAML comment mentions 12 cities. The data record, release README and paper identify seven. Per-image blocks remain unverified.
collections.summary_problem: 27 pothole boxes flagged. Site IDs absent.

collections.name: IRD Baghdad

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes. The release requests citation of its dataset DOI and responsible use of GPS metadata.

collections.resolution: Dashcam 3840 × 2160, drone 4000 × 2250, phone 4032 × 3024 (acquisition sizes in the data paper).
collections.acquisition: 1,006 Abask 4K in-vehicle dashcam frames, 2,162 DJI Phantom 4 drone images and 1,184 iPhone 16 Pro Max photos.
collections.capture_period: Approximately two winter months. Exact dates unverified.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned YOLO bbox text. Separate YOLO polygons and class/object PNG masks are also available.
collections.label_layout: Merge five ZIPs into the common images/ folder. Join images/<stem>.jpg to labels_bbox/<stem>.txt or use the GPS CSV paths. 401 background labels are empty. Use released data.yaml for the IDs.
collections.count_source: All 4,352 bbox text labels from the existing local archive with MD5 matching Zenodo. All labels match the GPS manifest and all 4,352 image names in the five ZIP directories. The paper describes a separate polygon count of 904 potholes.
collections.block_unit: GPS-derived road segment, dashcam clip or site (recoverable candidates)
collections.block_rule: Join gps_metadata/IRD_Dataset_GPS_Metadata.csv on image_name, label_name or paths. All 4,352 rows have lat/lon. Drone and Mobile rows also have alt_m and all Dash rows have t_sec. Dashcam clips are roughly one minute, sampled at 1 fps before filtering. The t_sec counter restarts on each clip. Use ordered Dash filenames plus candidate time resets and GPS continuity, because the table has no clip-ID field. Verify cross-camera segments spatially.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: Original Baghdad capture reported. Iraq is outside RDD2022. Verify image overlap using the protocol rule.
problems: Source prefixes distinguish cameras. Independent routes or sites still need to be recovered and validated.
Use bbox labels consistently. Polygon and bbox class counts differ.
collections.summary_problem: Derive and verify GPS road blocks.

collections.name: HRP4K

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes.

collections.place: Hangzhou, Huzhou and Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China.
collections.acquisition: Forward-oblique frames from vehicle-mounted Sony Alpha 7 IV and Alpha 9 III camera video.
collections.capture_period: Daylight, mainly dry conditions. Survey calendar dates unverified.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned YOLO text and COCO JSON.
collections.label_layout: HRP4K/{train,valid,test}/images/<id>.jpg joins labels/<id>.txt within the same split. COCO files are HRP4K/{train,valid,test}.json. Join strictly to real image members before counting.
collections.count_source: All YOLO labels paired to JPEG member names in the pinned v1.00 ZIP. Its full label set without image matching contains 7,217 boxes and 4,003 positive labels, matching the paper’s totals for 6,003 planned images.
collections.block_unit: Source video or road segment (IDs unresolved)
collections.block_rule: The authors grouped by source video for dataset splitting and extracted candidate frames at 3 fps before filtering. The pinned JPG names are numeric split IDs and the COCO image rows contain filename, dimensions and ID. No route, clip ID, GPS or timestamp mapping was found. Recover an author manifest or validate blocks by image clustering. The paper reports 170 positive source clips and says original filename prefixes encoded their IDs. The pinned JPEGs omit those prefixes.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: China is in RDD2022. The paper reports an independent Zhejiang survey. Its comparisons with external datasets provide no evidence of image reuse in the pinned release. Check China content overlap.
problems: Pinned V1.00 has 1,917 unmatched training labels and 4,086 actual images. Use the intersection of images and labels when preparing the manifest.
Source-video grouping cannot be verified from the numeric filenames or the COCO metadata alone.
Zenodo lists a newer V1.01 release. This inventory uses the specified V1.00 DOI. Confirm any proposed version change before using another archive.
collections.summary_problem: 1,917 missing training images. Clip IDs absent.

collections.name: Kent water-filled and dry potholes

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes.

collections.place: Kent County, United Kingdom. Specific towns/site IDs unverified.
collections.acquisition: Samsung Galaxy Note 8 phone photographs on roads and footpaths in varied day, night and weather conditions. Two additional front/rear dashcam videos are outside the labeled still-image set.
collections.annotation_format: Axis-aligned Pascal VOC XML and YOLO Darknet TXT.
collections.label_layout: Match IMG/Pothole-NNN.jpg to XML/Pothole-NNN.xml or TXT/Pothole-NNN.txt. The standalone XML/TXT listings have the same SHA-256 hashes as their ZIP entries. The published videos have no release labels.

pothole_classes.name: pothole
pothole_classes.note: Includes the one VOC o object.

collections.count_source: Literal pothole objects from all 713 XML labels in the local Potholes.zip with SHA-256 matching Mendeley. YOLO has 1,157 class-0 rows across 713 images. The paper reports 1,152 in the abstract and 1,157 in Section 2.
collections.block_unit: Road site or image cluster (site IDs unresolved)
collections.block_rule: The stills are numbered Pothole-NNN.jpg with no site or session key. Header audit found no embedded EXIF GPS or date tags. The dashcam video overlays have coordinates and speed but provide no verified join to stills or annotations. Recover site metadata or validate image clusters.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: The paper describes original Kent phone photos. The UK is outside RDD2022.
problems: XML/Pothole-487.xml has the single object name o. Its paired YOLO label assigns class 0. Use VOC for the conservative count and freeze the handling decision. Four VOC pothole boxes fail the frame-bounds/area check.
Still-image site/session IDs are unavailable. The two separate videos have no published per-frame boxes.
collections.summary_problem: Unmapped VOC object, four flagged boxes and missing site IDs.

collections.name: PDD2026 Indonesia

license.name: Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported
license.terms: Attribute the source. Adaptation and redistribution are allowed for noncommercial purposes.

collections.place: Bandar Lampung, South Lampung, East Lampung, Central Lampung, Metro City and Pesawaran, Lampung Province, Indonesia.
collections.acquisition: Oblique 30–45° vehicle-mounted Logitech C925e, Intel RealSense D455, GoPro HERO10 and Samsung Galaxy A55. The release adds handheld stills and selected GoPro and smartphone video frames.
collections.annotation_format: YOLO instance segmentation polygon text. Derive the enclosing axis-aligned box via min/max x and y per valid polygon.
collections.label_layout: FinalDataset_1024/images/{train,val,test}/<stem>.{jpg,png} joins labels/{train,val,test}/<stem>.txt. Use FinalDataset_1024/data.yaml. Interpret the class in each polygon row.
collections.count_source: All 6,332 same-stem image/label pairs in the v2 archive. The 1,688 count represents D40-equivalent polygon rows before conversion.
collections.block_unit: Road route or recording session (IDs unresolved)
collections.block_rule: Mendeley documents 2-second sampling at about 10–40 km/h for moving-vehicle capture and additional stills/selected frames. The archive names have class-like prefixes and sequence numbers. The release has no route/session or GPS index. Recover metadata or verify image clusters before assigning groups.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: The authors describe original Lampung field capture without image augmentation. Indonesia is outside RDD2022.
problems: Attribution and noncommercial terms apply.
Filename text such as Aligator can differ from the released taxonomy. Route/session blocks remain unresolved.

collections.name: UAV-PDD2023 Tianjin

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.terms: Give appropriate credit, link to the license, and indicate changes.

collections.place: Tianjin, China. Individual routes and sites unverified.
collections.acquisition: Downward-looking unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery at 30 m. The paper describes hovering and shooting while moving at 0.8 m/s.
collections.capture_period: Calendar dates unverified. Some captures followed rain by about an hour.
collections.label_layout: JPEGImages/<stem>.jpg pairs with Annotations/<stem>.xml. Read object/name and bndbox. class_names.txt also includes the _background_ sentinel, which is absent from the annotation objects.
collections.count_source: All 2,440 VOC XML labels paired to JPEGs. The three augmentation prefixes each have 65 Pothole boxes across 44 images. For all 44 positive crops, reversing each named transform yields identical box coordinates across all three variants. Keeping one variant per crop gives 65 boxes in 44 crops before any additional overlap screening.
collections.block_unit: Parent aerial photograph (inferred), then flight/road segment if available
collections.block_rule: Match ^(?:lr|tb|r180)_(\d+)_(?:top|bottom)_(?:left|right)\.jpg$ and group all quadrants and transform variants by the numeric token as a conservative inferred parent key. This gives 237 candidate parents and 814 distinct numeric-ID/quadrant keys. The archive supplies no flight/route ID, GPS or temporal spacing. Adjacent source photographs may overlap. Validate the parent rule and larger blocks on the pod.
collections.rdd_overlap_note: China is in RDD2022. Authors report original UAV acquisition and within-dataset augmentation. Check for overlap against RDD2022 China, including China_Drone.
problems: The 195 raw boxes include transformed copies. The one-variant-per-crop count is 65, below the protocol’s 150-box minimum. A raw tally of the transformed copies would exceed that minimum.
The published splits have distinct filenames but share inferred parent photographs. Route and flight independence remain unverified.
collections.summary_problem: 195 raw boxes collapse to 65 by crop. Parent IDs cross splits.

detectionbench_splits.gate_limit: The files establish the exported names only. Checkpoint-specific training and selection provenance, image content hashes, near-duplicates and class order remain unverified under G4c.
